result.title: OSGR: Observation-Support Graph Reasoning for Earth Observation Question Answering
result.summary: Answering geographic queries over Earth observation (EO) archives requires solving a joint retrieval-and-derivation problem under strict spatiotemporal constraints. Existing LLM agents fail to ground observation items or suffer from search-space explosion. We propose OSGR, a two-stage framework that factorizes this search into offline symbolic concept deduction and online Relation-Conditioned Grounding. OSGR leverages an offline Observation-Support Graph to deduce valid target-to-result support paths at the concept level, and applies spatiotemporal compatibility kernels to instantiate grounded observation-item sets. On Earth-Bench and DisasterM3-Reason, OSGR improves GPT-4o accuracy from 49.3\% to 63.7\% while reducing the execution-step ratio from 2.9 to 2.5.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OSGR 两阶段框架：离线构建 Observation-Support Graph，在概念层面推导目标到结果的有效支持路径，再在线以关系条件接地和时空兼容核实例化观测项集合，以缓解检索空间爆炸并提升地球观测问答准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用离线支持路径预筛候选证据、并以接地过程压缩执行步数的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与计算/停止分配提供可核查线索；但任务属遥感档案检索问答，与内部 latent 状态生成联系较弱。
